name: MiniMax M Plan Go

price.note: Or about $220 a year (pay for 10 months, get 2 free).

check.label: MiniMax console usage, or mmx quota

meters.label: 5-hour window
meters.hint: MiniMax console usage page, or mmx quota. 1x

reset.rule: A fixed 5-hour block starts at your first request. Your next request after it ends starts a new one.
stipulations: Covers text, speech and other models, but not image or video.
Usage is counted at each model's pay-as-you-go price. MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is $0.15 per million input tokens, $0.60 per million output and $0.015 per million cached reads.
Longer context, agent loops, higher effort and video use more.
MiniMax doesn't publish the quota in prompts or tokens.
Requests-per-minute throttles are separate and usually clear in about a minute.

meters.label: Weekly
meters.hint: MiniMax console usage page, or mmx quota

reset.rule: A 7-day window starts at your first request. Your next request after it ends starts a new week.
stipulations: Every model, including image and video, draws from this one pool.
The 5-hour and weekly windows reset independently. Unused quota doesn't carry over.

overage: Included quota is spent first, then prepaid Credits, soonest-expiring first. Credits last 1 year. About $1 per 1,000 Credits (third-party report, unconfirmed). An M Plan key never charges your account balance.

how: A 5-hour window and a weekly window, both started by your first request. Whichever runs out first stops you.
MiniMax gives quotas only as multiples of Go and publishes no absolute numbers.
Image and text models are included. Video and H3 Image Highspeed are not.
ext: MiniMax models only: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, H3 Image, speech, web search and multimodal understanding.
Claude Code: base URL https://api.minimax.io/anthropic, model MiniMax-M3.1-Flash[1m], with a 512K auto-compact window.
Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw or any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible tool works with an M Plan key. MiniMax Code needs no key. All share one quota.
quirks: M Plan keys and pay-as-you-go keys aren't interchangeable. Only a pay-as-you-go key charges your balance.
In Claude Code, thinking is always on. Setting CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL disables /effort. ANTHROPIC_* variables in your shell override the settings file.
No downgrades. Upgrades apply at once with the unused time credited. Annual subscribers can only upgrade to another annual plan.
Meant for one person's interactive use. MiniMax recommends pay-as-you-go for production.
M3.1-Flash-Preview is retired. Requests to it are served by M3.1-Flash.

Legacy Token Plan subscribers keep their price while auto-renew stays on. Turning auto-renew off is permanent, and upgrading to the M Plan drops old perks such as the 150% weekly limit, with no way back.
About 2 agents at once (third-party report, unconfirmed).
